# Closer

**Algo Strategy Value:** Closer

No parameters should be attached. Only the strategy needs to be specified as Closer.

#### Python

```python
order.algoStrategy = "Closer"
```

#### Java

```java
order.algoStrategy("Closer");
```

#### C++

```cpp
order.algoStrategy = "Closer";
```

#### C\#

```csharp
order.AlgoStrategy = "Closer";
```

#### VB.NET

```vbnet
order.AlgoStrategy = "Closer"
```
